observations.observation: An identical active value (language=German) was stored as a second record instead of reusing the existing record, increasing historical storage.
A third identical confirmation created another record, demonstrating repeated duplicate accumulation under deduplicate=false.
The query answered correctly but only needed the current identical value, so the extra duplicate records provide no task-success benefit.

hypothesis: Enabling deduplication will reuse identical active values, reducing stored records and duplicate retrieval distraction while preserving answers and hard-constraint behavior.
predicted_effect: Duplicate-confirmation should retain the correct German answer with fewer records; overall task success and write precision should remain unchanged or improve, while storage_records and likely distraction decrease.
